'''May 2001 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ on 5 May 2001. The Short And The Ugly (team: [[Jared Arthur]], [[Patrick Hug]]) won it. It is known from Jared Arthur's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2274">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-09-yodas-birthday-bashd2274/ yodas-birthday-bash], DeckTech (Jared "Don_Yoda" Arthur, 9 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-09-yodas-birthday-bashd2274/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 May 2001
* '''Site:''' The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' The Short And The Ugly (team: [[Jared Arthur]], [[Patrick Hug]])
